$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows (editors use it); ignored.

project.description: The project's name or id (a new name is created from the settings below); the CLI's --project wins.

maps.description: Level maps built from the tilesets; checked by the levels package (P4), passed through here.

defaults.description: Settings for every sprite (the same keys may also sit at the top level); a sprite's own keys win.

kind.description: What the model is (default: from the model).

class.description: Movesets: "rifle", ["rifle", "pistol"] or "rifle,pistol" (unarmed, sword, knife, bow, staff, launcher, rifle, pistol, martial_arts).

anim.description: Clip names, or with class the moves to keep ("idle", "crouch_*"); each may carry its own trim, cap, events and held items ("Clip@0.8:2.6", "Clip@max=2", or an Anim entry object). With class, installed clip names are extra clips under their own names.

template.description: Procedural moves: "still", ["crawl", "drive_turn:steer=25"]; with its own held items a Template entry object.

set.description: An animation set by id or name (not with class); "none" = only the declared anim/template moves (the default whenever any are declared).

states.description: Objects: "auto", "auto,destroyed@destroy", "auto,intact:drive,destroyed@destroy" or { "intact": { "template": "drive" }, "destroyed": { "asset", "transition" } } (no anim/set/class; a template next to states is the intact state's loop).

dirs.description: Directions: 1, 2, 4, 4d, 8, 16… (on an object in an iso view, 1 = one facing of that view), or the directions by name: "E", "N,S", ["N", "S"].

facings.description: Objects: 1, 2 or 4 grid-aligned facings (0 = use dirs).

slice.description: Objects on a diamond tile: "columns" (per-tile-column strips).

collision.description: Objects: full (whole hull), base (ground slice: a trunk), concave (the outline of the slice: curved walls, fences) or auto (default: vehicles, aircraft, buildings full; trees, poles base).

collisionHeight.description: Objects: the ground slice's height in metres above the bottom (default min(0.5, 15% of the height)).

pitch.description: Camera pitch in degrees (0 = side, 30 = 2:1 iso, 90 = straight down).

frame.description: Square frame size in px (the minimum with ppm/tile).

ppm.description: Fixed pixels per metre (a sprite's own ppm wins over the file's tile; next to its own tile, the tile wins with a warning).

tile.description: Tile lock "64x32" (iso diamond) or "32x32" (square): the scale from the game's tile; null/false on a sprite leaves the lock (own ppm, or fit).

metresPerTile.description: With tile: metres one tile covers (default 1).

scale.description: "fit": fit the model into the frame (UI icons), leaving the tile lock and ppm; or a number, the model's own size factor (1.3 = a boss 30% bigger, also "130%") at the same ppm/tile lock.

fps.description: Frames per second sampled from the clips.

mirror.description: true: render only right-facing directions; the engine flips the rest.

supersample.description: 1–4: render at N× and average down.

pixelArt.description: Pixel-art style (hard edges, model palette, 1 px outline).

palette.description: Pixel style colours: full, model or levels.

shadow.description: The drop shadow: off, low or high (false = off).

look.description: Look card: clean, pixel, hand_painted, stylized.

size.description: Size card: small (64 px), medium (128), large (256), xl (512).

format.description: Engine format: generic, godot4, unity, phaser3, pixi, aseprite, libgdx, gamemaker, rpgmaker, lpc (or a custom profile).

layers.description: Extra layers: normal, depth, uv, shadow.

uniform.description: Same frame size and pivot for every direction and clip (fixed scale); the project's sprites of one model with uniform at the same view share one frame and pivot.

atlas.description: Pack trimmed frames into atlas pages.

animPrefix.description: Animation key prefix, tokens {base} {asset} (default: the sprite's name; "" = bare clip_dir).

movePrefix.description: With one class: false = bare move names (keys "hero/idle_E", clips "idle") instead of "hero/martial_arts_idle_E".

maxSeconds.description: Cap every clip at this many seconds (a clip's own maxSeconds in anim wins).

gender.description: Clip gender: auto, Masculine or Feminine.

layered.description: Held items as separate aligned sheets: true / "mask" (hidden pixels cut away) or "none" (whole items); false (default): baked into one sheet.

light.description: Lighting (FB-060): day, dusk, night, overcast, desert_noon, arctic (default day), or a Light object.

pivot.description: Objects: the frame pivot in the data files: each direction's object anchor (default) or the model origin.

turret.description: Vehicles (FB-096): hull and turret as two sheets, the turret's mount per hull direction in the hull's meta: true, or the turret's own dirs "16" / { "dirs": "32" }; false = one sheet.

portrait.description: Characters (SF-FB-021): also a head-and-shoulders still <base>_portrait.png: true (256 px, 3/4, transparent), a size, "320x400,front,#203040" or a Portrait object; false = none.

split.description: Characters (FB-124): "waist" = a legs sheet and a torso sheet with a per-frame waist socket in both, to aim the torso apart from the walk; or a Split object; false = one sheet.

still.description: One-frame stills of clips or moves: "Victory_Pose@2.4" (source seconds) or a list, each a one-frame animation <Clip>_still per direction ("Clip@2.4=ending" names it).

title: ssg.assets.json
description: Declares the sprites (and tilesets) a game needs. `slop build` creates or updates each by name, renders what is outdated and downloads it into the game. Settings for every sprite go in `defaults` or at the top level.

sprite.title: Sprite
sprite.description: One sprite: a model and how to render it. Every key but name and asset may also sit in `defaults` or at the top of the file, for every sprite; a sprite's own keys win.

clip.description: The clip, or with `class` the move (idle, crouch_punch…).

trim.description: This sprite's window of the clip in SOURCE seconds: "start:end" (either side may be empty), [start, end] or { start, end }. It replaces the shared clip trim on the sides it sets.

maxSeconds.description: Cap this clip at this many seconds (after the trim); wins over the sprite's maxSeconds.

reverse.description: Play the clip backwards (SF-FB-017): a clip picked by name is exported as <Clip>_reverse; a move is reversed in place.

lockYaw.description: Lock the root's yaw (SF-FB-023): a punch that turns the body punches straight ahead in a side view; false plays the turn even when the shared clip edit locks it.

events.description: This sprite's own events for the clip, in SOURCE seconds (SF-FB-022). They replace the clip's shared events for this sprite; [] drops them.

autoEvents.description: false: no automatic events (footsteps, the key moment) in this sprite's clip.

label.description: The name the clip is exported under (default: the clip's or move's name), so one clip can appear twice with different windows.

still.description: One frame only (SF-FB-025): the pose at this many source seconds, exported as <Clip>_still unless label names it.

with.description: This clip's own held items (FB-074), as the sprite's `with`: one sprite, several loadouts. Exported as <as>_<clip>; the sprite's other hand-held items are put away during it.

as.description: The loadout group the clip is exported under (default: the first item's moveset, else its name).

release.description: What happens to the held items at the clip's `release` event (FB-103): hide (default), drop (falls and stays) or keep.

anim.title: Anim entry
anim.description: An `anim` entry as an object: one clip or move with this sprite's own trim, cap, events, export name and held items. The string form packs the same into the name: "Clip@0.8:2.6", "Clip@max=2", "Clip@reverse", "Clip@lockyaw", "Clip@hit=1.2@hit_end=1.4", "Clip@0:3=kicks_a", "Clip@still=2.4".

template.description: A procedural move and its parameters: "still", "crawl", "shoulder_fire:kneel=1", "drive_turn:steer=25".

with.description: The items held during this template (as the sprite's `with`).

as.description: The loadout group the clip is exported under (default: the first item's moveset, else its name).

release.description: What happens to the held items at the clip's `release` event (FB-103): hide (default), drop (falls and stays) or keep.

template.title: Template entry
template.description: A `template` entry as an object: a procedural move with its own held items, exported as <as>_<template>. The string form is just the template spec.

asset.description: The model of this state (default: the sprite's).

transition.description: The transition template played into this state ("destroy", "blast=1"), or null for none.

from.description: The state the transition starts from.

template.description: The state's looping template (objects have no skeletal clips).

collision.description: What the state collides with (FB-085): none (a blown gate), base, full, concave or auto.

state.title: State
state.description: One object state in the object form of `states`: `{ "intact": { "template": "drive" }, "destroyed": { "asset", "transition" } }`.

enabled.description: Whether the FX look is on.

intensity.description: How strong the glow is (1 = as authored).

blend.description: How the sprite blends over the scene: add (light, fire) or normal.

fx.title: FX
fx.description: The glowing FX look as an object (`"fx": true` is the default glow).

preset.description: The preset the other values start from (default day).

azimuth.description: Where the key light comes from, degrees around the model as the camera sees it: 0 from the camera, 90 from the right, -90 from the left, 180 from behind (day about -34).

elevation.description: Height of the key light above the horizon, 1–90 degrees (day about 48).

light.title: Light
light.description: Lighting as an object: a preset plus overrides. On a sprite it lights the model; on a tileset the same values grade the ground to match (FB-060).

dirs.description: The turret's own direction count (default: the hull's).

width.description: Width in pixels, with height for a non-square portrait.

angle.description: How far the character is turned from the camera: degrees (-180..180), or front, 3/4 (default, facing right), 3/4 left, side, side left.

pitch.description: Camera pitch looking down at the face, 0–60 degrees (default 0).

clip.description: The clip whose first frame poses the bust (default: the first idle, else the first clip).

portrait.title: Portrait
portrait.description: The object form of `portrait` (SF-FB-021): a head-and-shoulders still <base>_portrait.png (+ .json). The string form is "320x400,front,#203040".

at.description: Where to split: waist (the only place today).

legs.description: The moves of the legs sheet (default: idle and locomotion).

torso.description: The moves of the torso sheet (default: idle, aim, shoot, throw, reload).

whole.description: Also write the whole-body sheet <base> (every move) from the same job and framing (FB-126).

split.title: Split
split.description: The object form of `split` (FB-124): a legs sheet and a torso sheet with a per-frame waist socket in both.

name.description: The tileset's name (unique in the file): what the next run matches.

tile.description: "64x32" (2:1 iso diamond, the default) or "32x32" (square, orthogonal); default: the file's tile.

metresPerTile.description: Metres one tile covers (default: the file's, else 1).

noisePeriod.description: Period of the large-scale ground noise in tiles (default 4).

variants.description: Default random variants per corner combination (a terrain's own variants wins; default 1).

terrains.description: The terrains, by name or as Terrain objects.

pairs.description: Terrain pairs that get transition tiles ([["grass", "dirt"]] or ["grass,dirt"]), or "all" for every pair.

cliffHeight.description: Cliff face height in pixels for raised terrains (default tileHeight / 2).

mixes.description: Tiles where three or four terrains meet: auto (default: every mix while the tileset has few terrains), triples or pairs.

light.description: Lighting preset ("dusk") or a Light object, as a sprite's light: grades the ground to match (FB-060).

tileset.title: Tileset
tileset.description: One tileset: its tile size, terrains and which pairs blend. A declaration is the whole truth about a tileset (terrains it does not list are removed), and tiles that stay keep their ids, so maps made with it stay valid.

name.description: The terrain's name (unique in the tileset).

kind.description: What it is (default: the name if it is a kind, else custom): sets the default colour and water/shore behaviour.

color.description: Flat palette colour (default: the kind's). Not with texture.

texture.description: A texture instead of a colour: a texture path inside the packs, or an installed asset id.

scale.description: With texture: metres one repeat of the texture covers (default one tile).

tint.description: A tint over the texture or colour.

variants.description: Random variants of this terrain's tiles (default: the tileset's).

blend.description: Terrains to make transitions with (the same as listing the pairs).

height.description: 1 = raised one level: cliffs where it meets ground terrains (`cliff: true` is the same).

cliff.description: true = raised one level with cliffs (the same as height 1).

shore.description: Shore treatment where it meets another terrain (default: on for water).

terrain.title: Terrain
terrain.description: One terrain of a tileset: a colour or a texture, and how it meets its neighbours. A bare string is a terrain with that name.

sprite-defaults.title: Sprite defaults
sprite-defaults.description: The `defaults` object (and the same keys at the top level): every Sprite key but name and asset.
